summary: RETEST of Phase R-MARKET-1B (locale-aware frontend) after the 3 fixes from iteration_53. ALL 3 fixes verified PASS: (1) /api/storefront/public/mood-demo-studio-81a09e/markets now returns 7 active markets including spanish_latam(es-ES) and gcc_luxury(en-AE); (2) LocaleHead filters hreflang to SUPPORTED_LOCALES only — gcc_luxury(en-AE) is excluded from hreflang lists; (3) legacy `/` canonical now correctly points to /it-IT (tenant default) instead of sticky session locale. Backend: 29/29 tests PASS (test_phase_r_market_1a.py + test_phase_r_market_1b_locale_wiring.py + test_phase_e_1b_studio.py). Frontend: every supported locale subpath emits canonical + 7 hreflangs {it-IT, de-DE, fr-FR, en-GB, en-US, es-ES, x-default} + correct og:locale + correct <html lang>. Unsupported segments (/en-AE, /pt-BR, /ja-JP) and /auth/login correctly emit NO canonical, NO hreflang, NO og:locale. Footer Country·Language modal lists all 7 markets, picking spanish_latam navigates to /es-ES and persists on reload. Locale-aware storefront copy switches correctly: IT (Chi siamo/Servizi), EN-US (About/Services), DE-DE (Über uns/Leistungen), ES-ES (Sobre nosotros/Servicios).

issues: Spanish nav label 'Sobre nosotros' is wide enough that it visually overlaps the MOODforDESIGN™ logo at 1280px viewport. Needs spacing/wrap rule for long-locale labels.

Hero copy is partially un-translated on /es-ES: main heading reads 'ITALIAN DESIGN. TAILORED FOR VISIONARIES.' (English) while body paragraph is Spanish, and the closing tagline 'DUE PERCORSI. UN UNICO OBIETTIVO — trasformare la tua visione in realtà' is Italian. Out of scope for Prompt 1 (locale wiring), but should be flagged for the editorial team / translation backlog.

action_items: (Optional, non-blocking) Tighten header spacing in storefront layout so longer locale labels (es-ES 'Sobre nosotros', de-DE 'Über uns') don't overlap the brand logo at <=1280px.
(Backlog) Complete editorial copy translation for /es-ES hero — currently mixed English/Spanish/Italian. Not in locale-wiring scope.
critical_code_review_comments: LocaleHead.jsx now correctly double-filters hreflang via SUPPORTED_LOCALES — defends against future backend/frontend drift. Good defensive design.
isLegacy branch in LocaleHead.jsx forces canonical to defaultMarket.primary_locale when URL has no /<supported-locale> prefix — correctly handles both legacy `/` and unsupported segments like /en-AE.
isStorefrontPath() bails out early for unsupported locale segments → no SEO leak on /en-AE, /pt-BR, /ja-JP, /auth/login. Verified empty <head>.

Initial async cache load can produce a small window (~1-2s) where SEO tags aren't yet present on the very first navigation; subsequent navigations are instant due to module-scope CACHED_MARKETS. Acceptable for SSR-less SPA; crawlers running JS will hit the populated state.
Footer testid contract honored: footer-country-language, country-language-modal, country-language-pick-{code} (all 7 codes present).

success_rate.backend: 100% (29/29 tests pass across test_phase_r_market_1a, test_phase_r_market_1b_locale_wiring, test_phase_e_1b_studio)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on locale wiring scope (Prompt 1). All 3 previously-flagged issues resolved. Two pre-existing copy/layout polish items noted as non-blocking design observations.
